topic: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing
headline: 96% of B2B marketers use AI, but hiring is moving toward judgment and QA roles
keyNotes: A massive 96% of people who market products or services to other businesses (B2B marketers) are already using artificial intelligence (AI) in their work.
Even though AI is so widely used, companies are changing the types of jobs they are looking to fill.
Instead of just technical AI skills, new hiring is focusing on roles that need human decision-making and careful checking of work (these are called "judgment and QA roles").
This suggests that while AI can handle many tasks, human abilities like critical thinking and ensuring high quality are becoming even more valuable in marketing teams.
question: The article mentions that even with 96% of B2B marketers using AI, hiring is shifting towards roles that require human judgment and quality checks. In your own work, where do you think human skills like critical thinking and ensuring quality will remain irreplaceable, even as technology advances?
